title: Ice: Natural Earth 10 m glaciated areas and Antarctic ice shelves for the present, and the glacial deposits of Cao et al. 2018 as a check on the atlas-derived past
license: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)
note: The present day from Natural Earth: grounded ice (glaciers and ice sheets) and the floating Antarctic ice shelves as polygons in longitude/latitude; scripts/build_ice.py rasterises them onto the 0 Ma stop's texture grid. Every older grid takes the ice the 2016 PaleoAtlas paints on the nearest map, read by scripts/segment_paleoatlas.ice; no raster of the atlas is served. The third asset is not drawn: it is the compilation of glacial deposits (tillites, diamictites) of Cao et al. 2018, rotated to each map's age to count how many fall inside the drawn ice; see docs/globe-viewer.md "Ice".

assets.note: EarthByte supplement: coals, evaporites and glacial deposits since the Devonian as point shapefiles in present-day coordinates, once per plate model. Only PresentDay_LithData_Scotese2008_410-0Ma/PresentDay_GlacialDeposits_Scotese2008_410-0Ma.shp is read: 394 localities with FROMAGE/TOAGE; plates are assigned here from the PALEOMAP polygons at 0 Ma, not taken from the file.
